name: 400. Azure AI Speech: SSML speech, streamed speech and fast transcription (azure speech provider) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-6542 (contract C3, C4, C5, C6, C10, C12; Microsoft vendor sheet TTS · Azure AI Speech B1, B2 and STT · Azure AI Speech B1), local fixture regression with no live provider calls. Start provider-error-fixture.mjs and an isolated gateway using provider-error-fixture.config.json, whose azurespeech key carries the fixture as its resource endpoint (azure_key_config.endpoint), and enable providerErrorFixture=1 (README: Azure AI Speech). Every case is skipped otherwise. The fixture serves the text to speech API on /tts/cognitiveservices/v1 and fast transcription on /speechtotext/transcriptions:transcribe, and keeps every call in /__wire; each case resets the fixture first and reads back what reached it. Speech: the request reaches the vendor once, as SSML (voice name as given, speed as prosody rate, input escaped) with X-Microsoft-OutputFormat, and the audio bytes come back, on /v1 and on the OpenAI-compatible route. Streamed speech: the fixture writes three audio chunks 600ms apart and /__probe/stream-gaps times each speech.audio.delta, so each chunk must reach the client before the vendor writes the next one. Transcription: the multipart audio + definition (enhancedMode model, locales, an extra field merged in through x-bf-passthrough-extra-params) reaches the vendor once and text, usage{type: duration, seconds} and raw_response come back, on both routes. Refusals: instructions, an out-of-range speed and response_format srt return 400 caller_unsupported_parameter with nothing sent. Errors: a vendor 429 (also before the first frame of a stream) and a vendor 422 keep their status and carry error_type after exactly one upstream call, and a 200 with no audio is 502 provider_empty_result.
